purpose: Compact renderer requirements selected by grammar components and variant conditions.

requirements: Declare the numeric page id in both `page <id> (` and `page: <id>`.
For pNNNNN-<slug>.apx, set alias to the uppercase slug with hyphens preserved.
Place static-content regions in `layout.slot: body`; `contentBody` is for modal-dialog content.
Render a named `region breadcrumb (` block with `type: breadcrumb`, `source.breadcrumb: @breadcrumb`, and `layout.slot: breadcrumbBar`.
Add a shared breadcrumb entry whose pageNumber matches this non-modal page.
Place every non-breadcrumb region on a normal page in `layout.slot: body`; reserve `contentBody` for modal-dialog content.
Do not invent page template references.

decisions.when: No special page layout is requested or selected.
A special page layout is requested.
decisions.use: Its compiler- or contract-verified template; stop if unavailable.

requirements: Use `source.text` for plain text or `source.htmlCode` only when HTML is requested; do not add SQL.
Do not invent region template references.

decisions.when: Ordinary body content with no special shell.
A special shell or interaction pattern is requested.
decisions.use: A compiler- or contract-verified region template; stop if unavailable.

requirements: Use an object-valued `behavior.target` property; scalar page numbers and f?p URL strings are invalid.
Derive `layout.slot` from the verified parent region template; do not infer it from the region type alone.
Emit alignment, row/column flags, `hot`, icons, and template options only from explicit task intent or a selected construction contract.
Do not invent button template references or presentation choices.

decisions.when: Text-only button with no specialized template.
The task explicitly marks the button primary.

decisions.use: Select @/text-with-icon or @/icon from label intent; do not guess.
Apply workflow or app policy; do not force doNotCheck globally.
